content.body: does anyone know who the assigned reviewers for the Stage 2.7 (formerly Stage 3) decorator metadata proposal were?

from the notes, it sounds like we may have skipped that part of the process for this proposal: https://github.com/tc39/notes/blob/HEAD/meetings/2023-05/may-18.md#decorator-metadata-final-spec-text-review-for-stage-3
I could not have told you that I was the one to present that
Thank you for the update. I'm glad we now have most of the performance.
I wonder if this will be sufficient to convince build tools to avoid downleveling by default.
Good question. If you do find cases where the performance degrades unacceptably we'd certainly have a look.

before the split from decorators, reviewers were RGN, SYG, JHD, LEO

it doesn't look like any reviewers were assigned when it split off, and as the notes says:

> - The spec text is written and reviewed by one editor, KG.
